title: Don’t Go To Extremes: Revealing the Excessive Sensitivity and Calibration Limitations of LLMs in Implicit Hate Speech Detection
benchmark_measurement: Over-sensitivity to religious groups, measured by the misclassification of benign statements containing religious identifiers (e.g., 'Muslims') as hate speech.
findings: LLMs can exhibit excessive sensitivity towards statements involving protected groups, including religious ones. The presence of terms like 'Muslims' in benign, factual statements can confuse some models, leading them to misclassify the text as hate speech. This highlights a tendency for models to be over-cautious when encountering topics related to religion, even in non-hateful contexts.
